#1
परं|param|para — supreme, highest (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with jñānam in the second half of the sentence, anticipating the object)
भूयः|bhūyaḥ|bhūyas — again, further (adverb)
प्रवक्ष्यामि|pravakṣyāmi|pra-vac — to declare, proclaim (pravakṣyāmi: future 1st sg. 'I shall declare')
ज्ञानानां|jñānānām|jñāna — knowledge (gen. pl. 'among knowledges', partitive genitive with jñānam)
ज्ञानमुत्तमम्|jñānam uttamam|jñāna — knowledge (acc. sg. neut., direct object of pravakṣyāmi; simply written joined with the following word, -m unaffected before the vowel);;uttama — best, highest (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with jñānam)
--
यज्ज्ञात्वा|yat jñātvā|yad — which (yat: acc. sg. neut. relative, referring to jñānam; -t+j-→-j j-);;jñā — to know (jñātvā: gerund 'having known')
मुनयः|munayaḥ|muni — sage (nom. pl. masc., subject)
सर्वे|sarve|sarva — all (nom. pl. masc.)
परां|parām|para — supreme, highest (acc. sg. fem., agreeing with siddhim)
सिद्धिमितो|siddhim itaḥ|siddhi — perfection, attainment (acc. sg. fem., object of gatāḥ; simply written joined, -m unaffected before the vowel);;itas — hence, from here (itaḥ: adverb; -aḥ before g-→-o)
गताः|gatāḥ|gam — to go (gata: past participle 'gone', nom. pl. masc., predicate, 'have attained')
#2
इदं|idam|idam — this (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with jñānam)

मम|mama|aham — I (mama: gen. sg. 'my')
साधर्म्यमागताः|sādharmyam āgatāḥ|sa-dharmya — sameness of nature, having the same dharma [as] (sādharmya: acc. sg. neut., object of āgatāḥ; simply written joined, -m unaffected before the vowel);;ā-gam — to come to, attain (āgata: past participle 'come to, attained', nom. pl. masc., predicate)
--

प्रलये|pralaye|pralaya — dissolution (loc. sg. 'at dissolution')

व्यथन्ति|vyathanti|vyath — to be disturbed, waver (vyathanti: present 3rd pl. 'they are disturbed')
च|ca|ca — and
#3

#4

#5
